description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lunuwila, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District  - Cad. Map No. 410001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their owners, extent, encumbrances, and other land-related particulars. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
